name: GCC frozen validation pipeline
scope: Prospective evaluation of access-compatible EEG regime structure in independent datasets.
primary_claim: GCC is a theory-grounded, state-sensitive regime composite. It is not claimed to be generally bandpower-independent.

preprocessing.reference: average reference after non-EEG channel exclusion
preprocessing.per_channel_normalization: demean and divide by channel standard deviation
preprocessing.epoch_or_recording_crop: use first 90 s for anesthesia datasets unless shorter; use complete preprocessed epoched recordings when continuous duration is not available
preprocessing.artifact_policy: use public preprocessed data when supplied; otherwise reject recordings with unreadable files or fewer than 8 EEG channels

gcc_observables.R: mean Kuramoto order parameter across samples in the window from unit phase vectors
gcc_observables.D_eff: participation ratio of covariance eigenvalues from concatenated cos(phase) and sin(phase) channels
gcc_observables.M_tau: window-internal variance of instantaneous order parameter
gcc_observables.Pi: mean of the three binary regime conditions R_ok, D_ok, M_ok across windows

thresholding.for_external_state_datasets: calibrate on awake/baseline for each subject, then score target conditions without refitting

primary_endpoints.anesthesia_loss: paired baseline-minus-target Delta Pi in alpha and gamma; one-sided Wilcoxon baseline > target; paired Cohen d
primary_endpoints.altered_but_conscious_state: paired target-minus-baseline shifts in R, D_eff, M_tau and Pi, reported without assuming loss
primary_endpoints.sleep_state: Wake/REM/NREM classification in Pi/R/D/M space with subject-grouped cross-validation
primary_endpoints.degradation_proxy: clinical group classification and MMSE associations, explicitly not interpreted as conscious-access validation

baselines.criticality_proxy: available avalanche or 1/f slope proxy when raw data support it

validation_rules.cross_validation: leave-one-subject-out for within-dataset; train-on-one-dataset/test-on-another for cross-dataset
validation_rules.leakage_control: all thresholds and scalers fit on training/reference data only
validation_rules.reporting: always report negative and non-incremental findings

minimum_reporting: reliability or split-half estimate when window-level data are available

locked_interpretation.supported_if: GCC retains reproducible state sensitivity across independent datasets and survives phase-only/source-proxy controls.
locked_interpretation.not_supported_if: GCC fails to separate states above single-observable and spectral baselines, or effects vanish under phase-only/source-proxy implementations.
forbidden_claims: GCC is a proven neural correlate of consciousness
GCC is generally independent of spectral power
GCC validates terminal lucidity without direct TL data
